subject.title: feat: Discord channel-per-agent binding display in Gateway UI (ZZ-20260311-005)

question: Should configured route and ACP bindings be exposed to Control UI through a new `routing.list` Gateway RPC, or through an existing agents, channels, or config read surface?
rationale: The request adds a new core Gateway protocol namespace and a Control UI read model; current binding helpers exist, but repository policy treats Gateway protocol/API surface and UI ownership as maintainer-directed choices.

options.title: Approve a normalized read model
options.body: Define a stable read-only binding list contract, whether named `routing.list` or placed under an existing namespace, then review the linked implementation against that contract.

options.title: Use existing config reads
options.body: Avoid a new RPC and have Control UI derive the display from the current config read surface, accepting tighter coupling to raw config shape.

options.title: Defer the display
options.body: Keep bindings visible through config and docs for now and pause the implementation PR until a broader Control UI routing plan exists.

recommendation.title: Approve a normalized read model
recommendation.body: Define a stable read-only binding list contract, whether named `routing.list` or placed under an existing namespace, then review the linked implementation against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest current-main routing candidate for both recent Gateway method-table work and the current UI/config file layout, while the decision spans API and UI boundaries.
